a.title: ACCRUE INTEREST UP TO TODAY ON THE OPENING BALANCES. WHEN A MONTH HAS CLOSED, POST ITS INTEREST AND FEES. THE CHARGES COME IN MASTER ORDER, SO THEY ARE POSTED WITHOUT A SORT.
SORT THE DAY'S TRANSACTIONS INTO ACCOUNT ORDER AND POST THEM
SORT AND POST THE CREDITS OF THE TRANSFERS THAT POSTED
SORT AND POST THE RETURNS OF THE CREDITS THAT COULD NOT POST
APPLY THE DAY'S ACCOUNT MAINTENANCE, WRITING THE NEW MASTER
LOAD THE NEW MASTER INTO THE ONLINE ACCOUNT FILE, WHICH THE CARD AND ATM AUTHORIZATIONS READ DURING THE NEXT BUSINESS DAY
MOVE TO THE NEXT BUSINESS DAY
